test_steer_calls_agent_steer_and_does_no: test the gateway runner's /steer command calls agent.steer() without interrupting when an agent is running
test_steer_without_payload_returns_usage: test the gateway runner's /steer command returns usage help when called without a payload
test_steer_with_pending_sentinel_falls_b: test the gateway runner's /steer command falls back to queue semantics when the agent is in pending state
test_steer_agent_without_steer_method_fa: test the gateway runner's /steer command falls back to /queue when the agent lacks a steer method
test_steer_rejected_payload_returns_reje: test the gateway runner's /steer command returns a rejection message when agent.steer() returns False
